The criminal law has been set into motion based on the first information statement of Smt.MANASA .M..

The gist of the prosecution case is that the accused No.1 married CW-1 in the year 2014 and after the marriage accused subjected CW-1 to mental and physical cruelty by going to his native place Vijayapura and he never returned to meet CW-1.

Later when CW-1 came to his village,
the accused came along with CW-1 and later on 20-08-2021 the accused quarreled with CW-1 and again the accused went to his native place against wish of complainant and neglected to take care of CW-1 and her child and thus subjected CW-1 to physical and mental cruelty.
Based on the said information, a case in Cr.No.193/2021 came to be registered against the accused for the aforesaid offences.

10 . CW-1 was examined as PW-1 Smt.Manasa.

She in her examination-in-chief has deposed that her marriage with accused No.1 was performed during the year 2014 and deposed after the  5  C.C.No.21223/2022 marriage, accused looked after her well and deposed accused did not subjected her to any physical and mental cruelty, in demand of dowry and never abused, assaulted and threatened to kill her.
PW-1 deposed that there was petty quarrel between her and accused in respect to family issues, for which she went to the police station.
There the police have took her signatures on documents.
PW-1 identified Ex.P.1 first information statement and also identified her signature at Ex.P1.
PW-1 also identified Ex.P.2 spot Panchanama and her signature at Ex.P2 and she pleaded her ignorance about the contents of Ex.P.1 and P.2.
The learned Sr.APP treated PW-1 as hostile witness and cross examined her.
During which PW-1 admitted that she and accused have compromised the matter and denied all other suggestions.
11. On appreciation of entire materials on record, it is apparent that PW-1 being the informant, key and material witness have turned hostile to the prosecution case.
Therefore, this court was pleased to reject the prayer of the learned Sr.APP to summon other chargesheeted witnesses.

In view of the material witness, turning hostile,
and in the absence of evidence of material witness, the prosecution has failed to bring home the guilt of the accused beyond reasonable doubt.

Accordingly, I answer Point No.1 in the Negative.

For the foregoing reasons, I proceed to pass the following:
 ORDER
In exercise of power conferred Under Section 248(1) of Cr.P.C., Accused is acquitted of the offences punishable U/s. 498A of IPC.
The bail bonds of accused shall be in force for a period of 6 months.
